title: Add WhatsApp booking CTAs (main + floating) for 9953854470

requirements.summary: Add a visible “Book Now on WhatsApp” CTA that opens a WhatsApp chat to 9953854470.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible CTA labeled “Book Now on WhatsApp” is present on the website.
Clicking/tapping the CTA opens WhatsApp (or WhatsApp Web) to start a chat with number 9953854470.
On mobile devices, tapping the CTA launches WhatsApp if installed; otherwise it opens WhatsApp Web in the browser.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a small helper that centralizes the WhatsApp chat URL for business number 9953854470 (e.g., wa.me link) so both the main CTA and floating CTA reuse the exact same link.

Add a user-facing CTA labeled “Book Now on WhatsApp” within the existing Hero CTA area, linking to the centralized WhatsApp URL (9953854470). Use existing shadcn-ui Button composition (do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a persistent floating WhatsApp CTA button available across the entire single-page site using the same chat link.
acceptanceCriteria: A floating WhatsApp CTA remains available while scrolling (does not block core content on mobile).
The floating CTA uses the same WhatsApp chat link as the main “Book Now on WhatsApp” CTA (number 9953854470).
The floating CTA is accessible (keyboard focusable, has an accessible name).

file_operations.description: Create a fixed-position floating CTA component that links to the centralized WhatsApp URL (9953854470), is keyboard focusable, and includes an accessible name (e.g., aria-label “Book Now on WhatsApp”). Use existing shadcn-ui Button composition (do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the floating WhatsApp CTA into the app layout so it renders on top of all sections of the single-page site (persistent while scrolling) and uses the same WhatsApp link helper as the main CTA.

Add minimal global styling support (if needed) for safe-area and mobile-friendly positioning of the floating CTA (e.g., respecting device safe-area insets) to help ensure it does not block core content on mobile.
